caseNameFull: Frederick B. Lynch v. D. Darnell, Partners as Hazel-Darnell Mule Company

opinions.text: October 18, 1920. Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. Mr. Thomas D. O’Brien, Mr. Edward T. Young and Mr. Alexander E. Horn for petitioner. Mr. Pierce Butler and Mr. William D. Mitchell for respondents.
